relationships.subject: Morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: The opioid, morphine, initiates a Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling cascade that drives the activation of NOD-, LRR-, and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome proteins

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: initiates a Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4) signaling cascade that drives the activation of NOD-, LRR-, and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome proteins, resulting in cytokine production

key_findings: Review: morphine-TLR4-NLRP3 signaling drives cytokine production in a positive feedback loop; cannabidiol proposed as a modulator
